author: control-expert
nature: edition-9 design analysis; record replay of stage-5 diagnosis traces (seen data); no simulation run, no code change; not a judgement
commands: conda run -n dynamics-dev python -I -B scripts/d1_rule_eval.py <stage5_aa_diag> <this folder>
conda run -n dynamics-dev python -I -B scripts/d1_rule_tables.py <this folder>
conda run -n dynamics-dev python -I -B scripts/d1_rule_split.py <this folder>
conda run -n dynamics-dev python -I -B scripts/cp_and_delay.py <this folder>/cp_and_delay.json

inputs.traces: trace_<label>.json: 7 in the root (diagnosis 1), 7 traces_B, 7 traces_C, 34 traces_D, 20 traces_E (75; unique jobs 61, B and C repeat the 7 diagnosis-1 jobs with gyro samples)
inputs.code_reference: C8 worktree ed8-impl 56849248, 03_src/outrigger_sim/control/two_pressure.py 2034-2050 (_pressure_steps, |dp| > max_step_Pa), 2052-2078 (_unexplained_head_steps, |r_k - r_{k-1}| with the current M), 2085-2096 (_judge_head_steps, explained iff change < ratio * step force), 2098-2116 (_imu_residual_mass_kg, WARN_D1_IMU_GYRO_MISSING at 2112-2113, called only from 2067 after the empty-candidate return at 2062), 2005-2007 (_previous and previous f_z updated each read)

definitions.residual: r_j = sum_i (p_h,i A_p,i - p_r,i A_ann,i)(t_j) - M f_z,used(t_j) [N]; f_z,used = 10 ms partial mean of the IMU specific force (body z) minus the lever term when gyro samples exist; M = mass_kg of the judged period, used for every reference period (trace net_sum_N and f_z_used_m_s2)
definitions.candidate: leg with |dp_h| > max_step_Pa (100 bar in every traced monitor) in the judged period; threshold thr = 0.5 |dp_h| A_p [N]
definitions.C0: |r_j - r_{j-1}| >= thr (current D1'', reproduced: 0 mismatches against the traced is_unexplained over 300 candidate leg-periods)
definitions.Cd: C0 and |r_j - r_{j-2}| >= thr (r_{j-2} missing -> C0)
definitions.Ce: C0 at j, then FAULT at j+1 iff |r_{j+1} - r_{j-2}| >= thr_j; on actual faulted rows r_{j+1} is the post-fault trajectory (not a counterfactual)
definitions.Cf: C0 and not (some leg's net-force reading fell >= 50 % from j-2 to j-1 with >= 20 kN at j-2)
definitions.Cm: C0 and |r_j - median(r_{j-1}, r_{j-2}, r_{j-3})| >= thr (fewer than three valid references -> C0); valid reference = crawler lifted and f_z present
definitions.Cmo: |r_j - median(r_{j-1}, r_{j-2}, r_{j-3})| >= thr alone (not a subset of C0)
definitions.D1p: D1' sum rule |sum F_j - sum F_{j-1}| >= thr (spec 217.5), the reference of P-S8-14 (c)
definitions.injection: open-loop replay (spec 219.2 (d) method): persistent head offset J in {+100, -100, +150, -150} bar on one leg from period j on, every D1''-ready period j before the first head fault of the trace and every leg; adds J A_p to sum F of j and later, dp_h(j) -> dp_h(j) + J; detection judged at j (C0, Cd, Cf, Cm, Cmo, D1p) or j+1 (Ce); a jump missed at j has no later step candidate
definitions.kind: quiet = max_i |dp_h,i| <= 30 bar in period j, transient otherwise (spec 219.2 (b))
definitions.band: t_j - t_event: pre < 0, k0 [0, 0.1), k1 [0.1, 0.2) (judged against the lift-instant sample), k2 [0.2, 0.3), late [0.3, 2.5), tail >= 2.5 s

columns.prev_sample_minus_lift_ms: t_{j-1} - lift [ms], > 0 = sample after the lift

outputs.false_fault_rows.csv: candidate_periods rows with C0 True (21 leg-periods, 16 traces)
outputs.injection_detail.csv: one row per (trace, period, leg, jump); threshold_kN empty = not a step candidate; t_minus_event_s [s]
outputs.injection_summary.csv: unconditional detection per scope x jump (non-candidates count as missed)
outputs.injection_conditional.csv: detection among step candidates per scope x jump x rule
outputs.injection_by_band.csv: detection among step candidates per band x kind x jump x rule
outputs.cd_loss_rows.csv / cm_loss_rows.csv: injected jumps C0 detects and Cd / Cm does not
outputs.cp_and_delay.json: CP95 one-sided upper bounds beta.ppf(0.95, x+1, n-x); one-period delay bound (stroke = command x 0.1 s, load = stroke x stiffness, attitude = stroke / span)

limits: harness traces only: front RE1bF events, level/ready, F_s 0..2 kN, two sweep shapes; not the spec 219.2 (d) Chrono ML set
open-loop injection: no controller reaction to the injected offset
decisions after a C0 fault (rows after the first head fault) follow the faulted trajectory; Cd, Cm, Cmo verdicts at the decision period use only samples before it and are exact for that period
